page.notes: Reference marks in the text: the superscript "1" before "C'est" matches the note "Serm. de diverf. 122." (marked with an asterisk in the margin). The superscripts "2" and "3" before "renoncer" and "ne point" match the margin notes "Matth. 16. 24." and "Phil. 2. 4. 21." The numerals "1", "2", "3" inside the running text are enumerations and are copied as printed. "discip'es" is printed that way (a letter seems to be missing, likely "disciples"); copied as printed. The reference "2. 4. 21." is set with a space before "21", so I copied it as "21." Long s normalised to s throughout. The page is set in roman type, with the Scripture and sermon quotations in italic.
